Watson & Hines LLP
Pearland, TX
Phone 832-555-6543
Letter of Representation
13 Feb 2025
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1470
Our client: Larry Griffith
Date of loss: 31 Dec 2024
Dear Claims Representative:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above. Our client
sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on collision and has retained us to pursue all available claims arising from the
incident. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including rqeuests for statements, recorded
interviews, and settlement discussions, exclusively to this firm and do not contact our client directly.
We request that you disclose the full liability and bodily injury limits of every policy that may apply to this loss,
including any excess or umbrella coverage, and confirm the identity of the policyholder and all listed drivers. Please
provide this information in writing within fifteen days of receipt of this letter.
We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relatnig to this collision. This includes vehicle damage records,
photographs, telematics and event data recorder information, claim file notes, adjuster reports, recorded statements,
and any surveillance or third-party materials in your possession. Failure to preserve such material may result in
sanctions in any subsequent proceeding. We look forward to your prompt written response.
Sincerely,
Susan Johnson
Watson & Hines LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
